texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！

那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
texts.en:
Scientists from the [From.GetName] have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

They are emerging from subspace portals designated as L-Gates, and any attempts to communicate with them have failed. In the wake of their passage through the gates, we have detected emanating from the cluster they came from.
